details.name: Chen Qianyu
details.quote: ENDMIN! HOW ARE —— Oh. Okay, stick with the process. Here goes. Endfield operator Chen Qianyu, reporting for duty!
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Erudite: Mix of Every Stance Every school of martial arts has their own advantages. She merged them all and came up with her own. Nobody knew that an attack sequence could include four stances at once before she pulled it off.
details.exp2d: Epiphany: Flash of Insight "She only needs to see it once to master it." — This is not an exaggeration, by the way.
details.hb1d: Culture: Enlightenment by Rote Do not interrupt her when she's in the rare mood of reciting passages from the Biographies of Martial Masters from Great Yan. Unless you want to hear her recite the Boxing Manual for Red Browed Wing Chun again.
details.hb2d: Charity: Stand Up for Justice Altruism. Such is the essence of a true warrior.
